value.rationale: The Fano plane is the canonical smallest nontrivial finite projective plane. Its point–line incidence poset yields a natural dynamical example with exact permutation order 105 and restricted periods 3,5,7, seven collineation orbit types and an explicit contrast with chain-product homomesy. Exact orbit classification goes beyond an arbitrary numerical recomputation and supports comparative studies of incidence geometry and rowmotion.
